note: Erdae text of subjects (autonomy_l_english.yml), conquered lands (resistance_and_occupation_l_english.yml), the league windows (factions_l_english.yml) and the casus belli. The names of definitions the builder writes (templates, rules, goals, laws, states) are generated from the other data files; this file holds only wording the data does not carry. Keys under replace exist in the installed game and keep every placeholder; keys under english are ZIN's own.

english.zin_cb_broken_truce_desc: The Truce of the Grey Ford is broken, and the old quarrel between Gunwaith and Girdon lies open again.
english.zin_cb_old_grudge_desc: The West remembers every slight Parim ever offered it, and has cause to answer.
english.zin_cb_caravan_roads_desc: Blood was shed on the caravan roads, and Noris and Stabilo each hold the other to blame.
english.zin_cb_orc_raids_desc: Orc raids on the shores of the Sea of Darkness give the injured a just cause against those who sent them.
english.zin_cb_crown_defied_desc: The Golden Court will not suffer defiance. The Cursed Lands and the Bloody Forest have defied it, and the crown has cause.
english.zin_cb_against_the_dark_desc: While the Dark gathers, every honest crown has cause to take up arms against the dark powers and their servants.
english.zin_cb_eastern_ambition_desc: Eastern courts that hold footholds in the Magical Lands claim a right to take more.
english.zin_cb_free_east: Free of the King of the East
english.zin_cb_free_east_desc: Courts that refuse the King of the East have cause to strike at him and at the clients that knelt.
english.zin_cb_high_king: The High Crown of the East
english.zin_cb_high_king_desc: Noris and Stabilo, marching to unite the East, may call the unwilling courts to account.
english.zin_cb_hold_defiance_desc: Goldoroth has cause against any hold that refuses its tribute.
